rationale: Wikipedia: 'I Hate Everything About You' (released April 28, 2003) is the lead single from the self-titled debut album Three Days Grace (July 22, 2003); 'Rolling Stone Original' is a compilation, not the original release. | sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/I_Hate_Everything_About_You, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Three_Days_Grace_(album)
